candidates.name: GenImage
candidates.documented_scope: Million-scale AI-generated-image detection benchmark with real/nature images and AI-generated images across ImageNet content classes and multiple generators.
candidates.documented_split_structure: Per-generator train and val directories with ai and nature classes; official repository also documents full-dataset aggregation.
candidates.license_terms: Dataset homepage states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus additional Dataset Terms; non-commercial academic research use.
limitations: MANIPULATED maps specifically to AI_GENERATED for this lineage stage; it does not cover all local-edit/splicing/copy-move manipulations.
Real/nature images are collected from ImageNet, so source-domain and licensing/provenance inheritance must be documented during acquisition.
Generator coverage is historically bounded and does not imply generalization to future generators.

candidates.name: FaceForensics++
candidates.documented_scope: Facial manipulation benchmark based on original video sequences and Deepfakes, Face2Face, FaceSwap, and NeuralTextures manipulations; supports image/video classification and segmentation.
candidates.documented_scale: 1000 original sequences; ICCV paper reports over 1.8 million manipulated images.
candidates.access: Requires dataset access request/download process under FaceForensics Terms of Use.
limitations: Face-centric and mostly frontal-face source population.
Derived from video sequences, increasing grouping/leakage constraints for an image-level experiment.
Less suitable as the first broad-content AEGIS-Vision lineage than a content-diverse still-image benchmark.

candidates.name: ForgeryNet
candidates.documented_scope: Large face-forgery benchmark with real/fake image classification, localization, video classification, and temporal localization.
candidates.documented_scale: 2.9 million images and 221247 videos; seven image-level and eight video-level manipulation approaches.
candidates.license_terms: Repository states software use restricted to non-commercial research and educational purposes.
limitations: Face-forgery population rather than broad image content.
Large multi-task/multi-manipulation design adds complexity beyond the deliberately narrow first T1 experiment.
Acquisition/access reliability must be verified before any future use.

selection.reason: Best fit to the already frozen first-stage binary image task while providing broad content classes, explicit real-versus-AI-generated organization, multiple generator families, documented train/validation structure, authoritative repository/homepage, and research-use terms.
selection.scope_refinement: For the selected first experiment only, T1 MANIPULATED is operationalized as AI_GENERATED. Other manipulation families remain outside this experiment and may require later separately governed datasets.
